description: The Artchive™ is a channel where members can submit images to be archived. These could be artworks, memes, or literally anything. It's up to each server to decide what to use it for.
Members submit their images with a command, and Wynem posts them into the Artchive channel, along with their description and who submitted them.
Every submission comes with a delete button, which can be pressed by the submitter, or by members with the `Manage Messages` permission, to remove the submission.

tabs.name: Setting the Artchive channel
content: To set the channel where submissions are sent, use the <command:setartchive [channel]|serverconfig artchive set channel:[channel]> command. If no channel is provided, the current channel is used. This command requires the `Manage Server` permission.

data.title: Artchive channel set
data.description: The Artchive channel has been set to <#artchive>

content: To move the Artchive, run the command again with a different channel.

tabs.name: Submitting images
content: To submit an image to the Artchive, use the <command:artchive [description]|server artchive submit description:[description] image:[image]> command, attaching your image to the message. The description is required, and must be between `8` and `1024` characters.
For example: <command:artchive My GLaDOS model!|server artchive submit description:My GLaDOS model! image:glados.png>
Up to `4` images can be attached to a single submission, and they will all be added to the same Artchive post. Only image files are supported.
The submission is posted into the Artchive channel, and you are given a link to jump straight to it.

data.title: Image submitted
data.description: The image was successfully added to the Artchive

tabs.name: Viewing the Artchive channel
content: To check which channel the Artchive is set to, use the <command:viewartchive|server artchive view> command.

tabs.name: Removing the Artchive
content: To remove the server's Artchive channel, use the <command:removeartchive|serverconfig artchive remove> command. This command requires the `Manage Channels` permission.
You will be prompted to confirm you want to remove the Artchive.

data.description: Are you sure you want to remove the Artchive from <#artchive>?

content: Removing the Artchive only disables new submissions. The submissions already in the channel are left untouched.
